2607.15232.title: In-Place Tokenizer Expansion for Pre-trained LLMs
2607.15232.paper_summary: A tokenizer fixed at the start of pre-training allocates vocabulary in proportion to the pre-training corpus, reflecting the deployment priorities at that time. When those priorities shift, languages added later are split into many more tokens per word, which can raise latency, compute, and energy consumption for users of those languages. Cloud models can afford a broad vocabulary because the embedding and LM-head matrices are a small fraction of their parameters. On a compact model those matrices are a material share of per-token decode bandwidth, so on-device models ship small vocabularies and accept fragmentation outside a fixed language set. We present tokenizer expansion, an in-place recipe for upgrading a pre-trained model's tokenizer when the model producer controls its design. We continue the existing tokenizer's BPE merges on a multilingual corpus, so most source tokens carry over unchanged as single tokens and every new token has an exact decomposition into source tokens. We copy the carried-over embedding rows unchanged and initialize new rows as the mean of their source sub-token embeddings. A two-stage adaptation, embedding-only training then full-model continued pre-training, recovers source-checkpoint quality. We apply the recipe to a continued pre-trained checkpoint of LFM2-8B-A1B, an 8B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model, to help produce LFM2.5-8B-A1B with a 128K tokenizer. The expanded tokenizer encodes Hindi and Vietnamese in roughly $2.4\times$ and $2.6\times$ fewer tokens than the source (up to $4.0\times$ on Thai). Combining these reductions with the measured per-token cost of the larger vocabulary, we estimate a $2.2$-$3.7\times$ per-character decode speedup for these languages across our reference devices. We release the model weights and the expanded tokenizer, and report the negative findings that shaped the recipe.
2607.15232.paper_summary_zh: 一個在預訓練開始時固定的分詞器根據預訓練語料庫的比例分配詞彙，反映當時的部署優先級。當這些優先級發生變化時，後來添加的語言每個單詞被劃分為更多的標記，這可能會提高這些語言使用者的延遲、計算和能耗。雲端模型可以承擔廣泛的詞彙，因為嵌入和語言模型頭矩陣只是其參數的一小部分。在緊湊模型中，這些矩陣佔每個標記解碼帶寬的相當比例，因此設備上的模型提供小型詞彙並接受固定語言集之外的碎片化。我們提出了分詞器擴展，這是一種在模型生產者控制其設計時升級預訓練模型的分詞器的原地方法。我們在多語言語料庫上繼續現有分詞器的BPE合併，因此大多數源標記保持不變，作為單個標記，並且每個新標記都有一個精確的源標記分解。我們將保留的嵌入行保持不變，並將新行初始化為其源子標記嵌入的均值。通過兩階段適應，先進行嵌入專用訓練，然後進行完整模型的持續預訓練，恢復源檢查點質量。我們將這一方法應用於LFM2-8B-A1B的持續預訓練檢查點，這是一個具有8B參數的專家混合模型，以幫助生成LFM2.5-8B-A1B，並使用128K的分詞器。擴展的分詞器對印地語和越南語的編碼大約比源少$2.4\times$和$2.6\times$的標記（對泰語可達$4.0\times$）。將這些減少與更大詞彙的每標記成本相結合，我們估計這些語言在我們的參考設備上每字符解碼速度提升$2.2$-$3.7\times$。我們釋放模型權重和擴展的分詞器，並報告塑造這一方法的負面發現。
